title: The strictly standard relations split the localized conormal differential
statement: Let R and A be commutative rings with an R-algebra structure on A, and let P be a finite polynomial presentation of A on n variables with m relations [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Fix c ≤ min(n,m) and a in A. Suppose a is the stated finite linear combination of all c-by-c Jacobian minors of the initial c relations, and P.σ(a) times each remaining relation belongs to the ideal generated by the initial relations plus the square of the full relation ideal (the two conditions of [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element]). Then the base change to A_a [def-weil-ring-localization-away, def-weil-module-base-change] of the conormal differential of this specified presentation has an A_a-linear left inverse. This is a statement about the original localized conormal map, without asserting formal smoothness or presenting A_a.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07CA, first paragraph of proof, through the assertion that the localized differential has a left inverse; matrix calculation Tag 07ET

proof.text: In the polynomial cotangent-space basis the composition D E, with E sending the c standard basis vectors to the initial relation classes, has the Jacobian matrix M. The displayed combination of transposed maximal minors belongs to the minors ideal. Apply the scalar left inverse lemma to get B M = a times identity.

In I/I² the remaining relation condition reads a[f_j] in the span of the initial classes. After localization a is a unit, so E is surjective. Base change the matrix equation; rescaling B by the inverse of a gives a left inverse for D E.

The left inverse of D E makes E injective; together with surjectivity this makes E an isomorphism. The composite E times the left inverse of D E splits D. For c=0 the conormal module is zero by surjectivity of E; zero localizations also satisfy the identity.

lean.statement:
theorem strictlyStandard_localized_conormal_split
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    {n m c : ℕ} (P : Presentation R A (Fin n) (Fin m))
    (hc : c ≤ min n m) (a : A)
    (a' : {s : Finset (Fin n) // s.card = c} → A)
    (hminor : a = ∑ s : {s : Finset (Fin n) // s.card = c}, a' s *
      Matrix.det (fun j i : Fin c =>
        MvPolynomial.aeval P.val (MvPolynomial.pderiv (s.val.orderEmbOfFin s.property i)
          (P.relation (Fin.castLE (le_trans hc (min_le_right n m)) j)))))
    (hrelations : ∀ j : Fin m, c ≤ j.val →
      P.σ a * P.relation j ∈
        Ideal.span {f | ∃ k : Fin m, k.val < c ∧ f = P.relation k} +
          (Ideal.span (Set.range P.relation)) ^ 2) :
    ∃ l : (Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P.toExtension.CotangentSpace) →ₗ[Localization.Away a]
        (Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P.toExtension.Cotangent),
      l.comp (P.toExtension.cotangentComplex.baseChange (Localization.Away a)) =
        LinearMap.id
